recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-13544 unless future terminology migration changes where Address.type mappings are authored.
issue_request: FHIR-13544 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core vocab and asked that Postal no longer map to v3 PHYS and Physical no longer map to v3 PST on the Address Type ConceptMap.
initial_application: FHIR-13544 was applied in svn revision 13450, represented by git commit b5df8bba4113e4da62899eae095c604d4e1622d2 with subject "GF#13544 - fix addres type mappings". That commit changed source/datatypes/address.xml so postal maps to AddressUse.PST and physical maps to AddressUse.PHYS.
additional_context: FHIR-14461 later reported the same swapped mapping and says it was already fixed. The current build still includes Address as an active datatype, and the authoritative Address spreadsheet continues to carry the corrected mapping.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already matches the FHIR-13544 request.

related_jiras.note: Later Published tracker reported the same swapped postal/physical v3 mapping and records that it was already fixed.
